title: The noisy morning
text: Several small demands arrive at once, before the day has settled.

choices.label: Choose one manageable task
choices.result: I gave one task enough attention instead of carrying the whole morning.
choices.followup: Looking back: I gave one task enough attention instead of carrying the whole morning.

choices.label: Arrange practical help
choices.result: Paid practical help made the morning manageable.
choices.followup: Looking back: Paid practical help made the morning manageable.

choices.label: Try to finish everything
choices.result: Trying to answer every demand left the morning tense.
choices.followup: Looking back: Trying to answer every demand left the morning tense.

title: The crowded calendar
text: The calendar has room for every commitment only if nothing takes longer than planned.

choices.label: Leave room between commitments
choices.result: I made room for ordinary delays.
choices.followup: Looking back: I made room for ordinary delays.

choices.label: Pay to share a task
choices.result: Sharing a task reduced what the calendar demanded of me.
choices.followup: Looking back: Sharing a task reduced what the calendar demanded of me.

choices.label: Promise the full calendar
choices.result: The full calendar left no room for a difficult day.
choices.followup: Looking back: The full calendar left no room for a difficult day.

title: The changed plan
text: A changed plan threatens to turn the whole day into catching up.

choices.label: Make a smaller new plan
choices.result: I chose a smaller plan that matched the changed day.
choices.followup: Looking back: I chose a smaller plan that matched the changed day.

choices.label: Ask for paid practical support
choices.result: Support gave the changed plan some breathing room.
choices.followup: Looking back: Support gave the changed plan some breathing room.

choices.label: Keep chasing the original plan
choices.result: Chasing the old plan added strain to the new one.
choices.followup: Looking back: Chasing the old plan added strain to the new one.

title: The unfinished task
text: An unfinished task keeps following you into time meant for rest.

choices.label: Set a clear stopping point
choices.result: I set a stopping point without pretending the task was finished.
choices.followup: Looking back: I set a stopping point without pretending the task was finished.

choices.label: Pay for help finishing it
choices.result: Paid help closed part of the task without consuming my rest.
choices.followup: Looking back: Paid help closed part of the task without consuming my rest.

choices.label: Keep working through rest
choices.result: The task followed me through the time I needed to recover.
choices.followup: Looking back: The task followed me through the time I needed to recover.

title: The empty place
text: A familiar occasion makes {person}’s absence especially noticeable.

choices.label: Make room for the memory
choices.result: I made room for the absence and what the person meant to me.
choices.followup: Looking back: I made room for the absence and what the person meant to me.

choices.label: Arrange a supported remembrance
choices.result: A supported remembrance let me share the difficult occasion.
choices.followup: Looking back: A supported remembrance let me share the difficult occasion.

choices.label: Avoid acknowledging the absence
choices.result: Avoiding the absence made the occasion harder to face.
choices.followup: Looking back: Avoiding the absence made the occasion harder to face.

title: The ordinary reminder
text: An ordinary detail unexpectedly brings {person} to mind.

choices.label: Let the memory have a moment
choices.result: I let an ordinary reminder belong to my story.
choices.followup: Looking back: I let an ordinary reminder belong to my story.

choices.label: Book help talking it through
choices.result: Talking the reminder through helped me carry it more gently.
choices.followup: Looking back: Talking the reminder through helped me carry it more gently.

choices.label: Fill the moment with demands
choices.result: Filling the moment with demands kept the strain close.
choices.followup: Looking back: Filling the moment with demands kept the strain close.

title: The story worth keeping
text: You consider how to keep a story about {person} without making every day a memorial.

choices.label: Keep a simple personal memory
choices.result: I kept a simple memory without demanding constant remembrance.
choices.followup: Looking back: I kept a simple memory without demanding constant remembrance.

choices.label: Arrange help sharing the story
choices.result: Support helped me share the story in a manageable way.
choices.followup: Looking back: Support helped me share the story in a manageable way.

choices.label: Put every reminder away
choices.result: Putting every reminder away left the story harder to approach.
choices.followup: Looking back: Putting every reminder away left the story harder to approach.

title: The different anniversary
text: This anniversary of losing {person} feels different from the previous one.

choices.label: Allow a different way to remember
choices.result: I allowed the anniversary to have its own shape.
choices.followup: Looking back: I allowed the anniversary to have its own shape.

choices.label: Arrange a supported day
choices.result: A supported day gave the anniversary room without taking the whole week.
choices.followup: Looking back: A supported day gave the anniversary room without taking the whole week.

choices.label: Demand that I feel nothing
choices.result: Demanding no feelings added pressure to the anniversary.
choices.followup: Looking back: Demanding no feelings added pressure to the anniversary.

title: The invitation gap
text: There is space in your week for company, but reaching out feels awkward.

choices.label: Plan a small reachable meeting
choices.result: I made a small plan for company that I could actually keep.
choices.followup: Looking back: I made a small plan for company that I could actually keep.

choices.label: Join a paid supported group
choices.result: A supported group gave connection a place in my week.
choices.followup: Looking back: A supported group gave connection a place in my week.

choices.label: Leave the week empty
choices.result: Leaving the space empty kept the sense of isolation.
choices.followup: Looking back: Leaving the space empty kept the sense of isolation.

title: The unsent message
text: An unsent message has become harder to send each time you return to it.

choices.label: Send a simple honest message
choices.result: I made the first contact small enough to attempt.
choices.followup: Looking back: I made the first contact small enough to attempt.

choices.label: Use a supported conversation
choices.result: Support helped me start the conversation I had avoided.
choices.followup: Looking back: Support helped me start the conversation I had avoided.

choices.label: Keep postponing contact
choices.result: Postponing contact made the distance feel larger.
choices.followup: Looking back: Postponing contact made the distance feel larger.

title: The familiar room
text: Being in a familiar room does not automatically make you feel connected.

choices.label: Choose a manageable shared activity
choices.result: I chose a shared activity that gave company something to grow around.
choices.followup: Looking back: I chose a shared activity that gave company something to grow around.

choices.label: Arrange a supported group activity
choices.result: A supported activity made room for participation at my pace.
choices.followup: Looking back: A supported activity made room for participation at my pace.

choices.label: Pretend company is unnecessary
choices.result: Pretending I needed no company left the room feeling distant.
choices.followup: Looking back: Pretending I needed no company left the room feeling distant.

title: The uneven friendship
text: You want company without asking one friendship to meet every need.

choices.label: Make a modest plan for contact
choices.result: I kept the friendship and made my expectations manageable.
choices.followup: Looking back: I kept the friendship and made my expectations manageable.

choices.label: Use a group alongside friendship
choices.result: Group support widened connection without replacing the friendship.
choices.followup: Looking back: Group support widened connection without replacing the friendship.

choices.label: Expect one person to fix everything
choices.result: Expecting one person to fix everything added pressure to connection.
choices.followup: Looking back: Expecting one person to fix everything added pressure to connection.

title: The never-ending list
text: Finishing one demand only seems to reveal the next one.

choices.label: Set a smaller daily limit
choices.result: I set a smaller limit and kept room for recovery.
choices.followup: Looking back: I set a smaller limit and kept room for recovery.

choices.label: Arrange help sharing demands
choices.result: Practical help shared the demands instead of just hiding them.
choices.followup: Looking back: Practical help shared the demands instead of just hiding them.

choices.label: Push harder each day
choices.result: Pushing harder made each new demand feel heavier.
choices.followup: Looking back: Pushing harder made each new demand feel heavier.

title: The late work request
text: A late work request arrives after the shift should have ended.

choices.label: Protect the end of the shift
choices.result: I protected the end of the shift with a clear handover.
choices.followup: Looking back: I protected the end of the shift with a clear handover.

choices.label: Arrange practical work support
choices.result: Practical support reduced the load behind the late request.
choices.followup: Looking back: Practical support reduced the load behind the late request.

choices.label: Remain available every evening
choices.result: Constant availability kept work inside the time meant for rest.
choices.followup: Looking back: Constant availability kept work inside the time meant for rest.

title: The study pile
text: A pile of study tasks makes taking a break feel like losing ground.

choices.label: Study a smaller realistic block
choices.result: I kept study manageable rather than making rest a failure.
choices.followup: Looking back: I kept study manageable rather than making rest a failure.

choices.label: Arrange supported study time
choices.result: Supported study time reduced the load around the work.
choices.followup: Looking back: Supported study time reduced the load around the work.

choices.label: Study through every break
choices.result: Studying through every break made concentration harder.
choices.followup: Looking back: Studying through every break made concentration harder.

title: The praised exhaustion
text: Being praised for carrying so much makes a lighter workload feel like letting people down.

choices.label: Keep a clear limit on demands
choices.result: I accepted the praise without offering every spare hour.
choices.followup: Looking back: I accepted the praise without offering every spare hour.

choices.label: Arrange help with the workload
choices.result: Shared help made the workload less dependent on exhaustion.
choices.followup: Looking back: Shared help made the workload less dependent on exhaustion.

choices.label: Accept every new demand
choices.result: Accepting every demand kept exhaustion inside the achievement.
choices.followup: Looking back: Accepting every demand kept exhaustion inside the achievement.
